title: Page 191
transc:
Ft Monroe June 9. 1864
R OBrien Gen Butlers Hd. Qrs.
Appian pony fanny Ghost for Knox unity yours of Cora
just received and as the boat was leaving I went
down at once to direct one of my officers to
explain verbally & fully my situation here pedlar as he
may reach you before this does Zebra the orders of
Jolly are so distinct for me to remain here with
my special material till his further orders pekin but ready
to move at short notice pedlar that I fear to
leave without such orders Pekin or those of John Zodiac
Should the presence of myself spit & material be tarquin
with you pedlar would not this be safely accomplished for
me Pekin by an order of Pandora Come stock now
with you give sligo name of Jersey sugar Webster H
W. Ben ham palsy polkaing Randolph pelican Viola cloudy windy
Geo D Sheldon


Fortress Monroe June 9 - 1864
R O'Brien Gen. Butlers Hd Qr's
silver randolph panther appian Jennie pony for Knox unity
Dear shelby pekin a rumor has just reached me
utophia which may however not be true utophia that
you have many vessels up there loaded with stone
ready to sink sligo channel pedlar I suppose to
prevent the coming down torch walpole vessels unity If
true and this is not already arranged for allow
me to suggest that these vessels should if possible
(over)
